playstyle: Stand behind the line and keep the chant running. Drop the circle where the fight is breaking, not where the fight started: the cleanse, not the tick, is what keeps the front rank alive. The revival is a war-window button, not a panic button. Never expect to out-heal a burst; expect to out-last it.

abilities.name: Tending Rite
abilities.notes: Channel 1.2 s on one ally, then 90 HP (+0.5 per WIS) over 3.0 s. The heal stops at the missing HP, so it never tops anyone up. Single target, no cast while moving faster than a walk.

abilities.name: Steady Arms
abilities.notes: +12% attack speed and +25% stamina regeneration for 12 s for the cleric and for every ally within 6 m. Baseline kit of the acolyte branch; the cleric keeps it and builds on it.

abilities.name: Chant of Steady Hands
abilities.notes: The core heal. A circle of 8 m at the cleric's feet, 12 s, ticked every 1.0 s: 8 HP (+0.5 per WIS) to every ally inside. Every 5 s the chant strips one debuff from one ally inside, highest threat first, then lowest HP. Costs 30 mana to open and 2 per tick. Breaks if the cleric leaves the circle, takes a hit, or is silenced.

abilities.name: Oaken Ward
abilities.notes: A shield on one ally within 12 m: 220 (+0.5 per WIS) absorbed damage for 12 s. It absorbs before HP, expires empty, and does not stack with itself. A barrier, not a heal: it stops damage, it does not give health back.

abilities.name: Binding Word
abilities.notes: On one enemy within 25 m: 40 (+0.4 per WIS) damage and a 35% slow for 6 s. Slows do not stack; the stronger slow wins and the weaker one is dropped. The only ranged answer the cleric owns.

abilities.name: Pilgrim's March
abilities.notes: +25% move speed and +30% stamina regeneration for 8 s for the cleric and every ally within 10 m. Any damage taken by an affected ally ends its share of the effect. Used to pull a line out of a collapsing position, never to chase.

abilities.name: Hymn of the Long Watch
abilities.notes: A 9 m circle for 10 s, ticked every 1.0 s: 12 HP (+0.5 per WIS) per ally inside, and -12% damage taken by everyone inside. One debuff is stripped at 3 s and one at 8 s. The chant, upgraded: fewer ticks, more per tick, and the party takes less.

abilities.name: Unbroken Vigil
abilities.notes: The revival. It must be started on the fallen ally's tomb marker and the marker must be within 30 m; no marker, no revive. 6 s channel, interrupted by damage. The ally returns with 40% HP, no mana, and loses 25% of the XP they need for their next level. A tomb marker stands where a warden dies for the whole war window and shows the name and the time of death. 300 s cooldown, so it is a war-window button.

abilities.name: Sundered Vow
abilities.notes: Marks one downed enemy within 30 m. Enemy healers cannot revive that enemy for 40 s. The mark ends when the timer ends, when the enemy is revived anyway, or on a dispel. Counts as a hostile mark on the enemy HUD.

abilities.name: Hymn of the Last Dawn
abilities.notes: The capstone. A 12 m circle for 15 s, ticked every 0.67 s: 10 HP (+0.5 per WIS) per ally inside, -10% damage taken by everyone inside, and one debuff stripped every 2 s from the worst-affected ally. Ends the moment the cleric leaves the circle. 240 s cooldown, 120 mana: one per war, used where the line breaks.

weakness: No burst heal and no escape. The chant needs 1.5 s to open and dies on a single hit to the cleric, so any damage that lands faster than a tick wins the trade: an assassin opener, a cannon volley, a reaper's dash. A dispel or a silence removes the whole kit at once. The cleric also loses every duel of attrition it is not standing in the middle of.
